svg.title: Scaffolder — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as scaffolder, wearing a safety vest and a hard hat. Visible work cue: Two scaffold uprights support two platforms and crossed diagonal braces. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
